The Skjergard area, with its virtually untouched small islands, islets and skerries and their associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds, including eider ducks and several species of gull.”

hisasen-naturreservat-nat2d99ac24.d: The Hisåsen Nature Reserve is situated in the north of Ertvågsøya in Aure municipality, and covers just over 2,900 dekar. The reserve consists of the prominent Hisåsen hill (180 metres above sea level) in the south, and the gentler slope down towards the sea in the north. The bedrock consists of granite, gabbro and amphibolite. The vegetation alternates between woodland and bog types, and is generally species-poor. Logging has taken place in the area in the past, but trees over 250 years old have now been identified. The reserve is typical of the bog-rich, nutrient-poor coastal pine forest.

hendvagen-naturreservat-nate4e71ea4.d: Hendvågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Averøy municipality. It comprises an area around Hendvågen that separates Henda from Averøya. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Bird species observed here include the Red Listed species black-headed gull and common gull.

maslia-naturreservat-natb6a67a36.d: Måslia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Ålesund and Vestnes. It comprises an area on Ørskogfjellet by the E39 between Sjøholt and Vestnes. The reserve is separated from Nysætervatnet Nature Reserve by the E39. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a rare, large and untouched mire area of value as a national type site.’

nupafjellet-naturreservat-nat16b454c2.d: The Nupafjellet Nature Reserve comprises a section of Gurskøya in Sande municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 28 May 2010, along with 35 other protected areas in the county, and forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the reserve by land is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of particular value for biodiversity’. The area is an unspoilt, steep coastal area with heathlandand bog vegetation, bare rocky outcrops and cliffs, which, together with the surrounding marine area and its naturally associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding site for several species of gulls and eider ducks.”

gylhamran-naturreservat-nat7c0dac0c.d: Gylhamran Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Tingvoll municipality. It comprises an area by the Tingvollfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the most species-rich and best-studied deciduous forest sites in the county, with its natural flora and fauna.’

unjemslia-naturreservat-natc611d1fd.d: Unjemslia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Rauma municipality. It comprises an area further up the valley to the east of Isfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests/rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a deciduous forest habitat with thermophilic forest vegetation and its natural flora and fauna. Among its special features, it is worth noting that the area has a rich occurrence of the white helleborine (Cephalanthera longifolia).’

oltervagen-naturreservat-nat5c37991a.d: Oltervågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area at the mouth of the Olteråa river in Fannefjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a rare habitat type with species-rich salt marshes, as well as a wave-cut platform as a distinctive landscape feature at the mouth of the Olteråa river’. The Olteråa river is regulated by the Istad, Langli and Grønnedal power stations. However, the landscape in the river estuary and the nearest delta remains relatively unspoilt. This is an important area for seabirds, waterbirds and other birds associated with wetlands.

svin-ya-naturreservat-natb100c6fb.d: Svinøya Nature Reserve consists of a small, isolated island out at sea in Herøy municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. Svinøy Lighthouse is located within the protected area. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats’.

h-gsetleira-naturreservat-nat6013b4fb.d: Høgsetleira Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Gjemnes municipality. It comprises an area by Gjemnessundet. The area was designated a protected area on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a species-rich salt marsh area with minimal human intervention, as a reference and model area for salt marshes of the land-uplift type.’

todals-ran-naturreservat-natfa6f23ec.d: Todalsøran Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Surnadal municipality. It comprises an area at the head of Todalsfjorden, at the mouth of the Toåa river. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a relatively untouched river delta with botanical, zoological and geomorphological conservation values.’

stakkengfonna-naturreservat-nat1c4a93d5.d: Stakkengfonna Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area just east of Litlevatnet in Eikesdalen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the best-developed elm forest sites in Eikesdalen, with its natural flora and fauna.’

skalmen-naturreservat-natdbf61d38.d: Skalmen Nature Reserve consists of a couple of islets in the archipelago north-west of Smøla in Smøla municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The virtually untouched, high and weather-beaten rocky islet, together with the surrounding marine area and its naturally associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding site for seabirds, particularly red-billed terns.’

nauste-naturreservat-nat01ea1343.d: Nauste Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises the area around the mouths of the Eira and Dokkelva rivers where they flow into Eresfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for seashores and river deltas. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve the largest and most intact river delta in the county. This is a typical area for a large salt marsh complex on a delta. The original biological function and landscape character are intact and are of great botanical, zoological and geomorphological conservation interest.’ There is a Bronze Age/Iron Age burial ground located partly within the reserve.

raudnesvika-naturreservat-nat9ea0d3c5.d: Raudnesvika Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sula municipality. It consists of a mountainside along the Sulafjord, stretching from Eltraneset via Raudnesvika to Oksavik. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large and virtually untouched coastal forest area, comprising, amongst other things, thermophilic deciduous forest with its natural flora and fauna and all its natural ecological processes.’

remman-naturreservat-nat6d2a5596.d: Remman Nature Reserve consists of a marine area north-west of Veidholmen in Smøla municipality, Møre og Romsdal. It comprises small islets and skerries, but almost the entire area is marine. The area was designated a nature reserve on 9 January 2009 as one of eight nature reserves and two landscape conservation areas in the municipality. The reserve is included in the seabird conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an unspoilt and internationally valuable coastal area, with its naturally associated flora and fauna, and ecological functions. The area is of particular value as a wintering ground and breeding site for birds, and as a habitat for otters and white-tailed eagles. The area also features a particularly large and well-developed kelp forest.

vindfarholmen-naturreservat-nate36312d8.d: Vindfarholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet off Berkneset in Volda municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The virtually untouched islet, with its surrounding marine area and the flora and fauna naturally associated with it, constitutes an important breeding site for seabirds, particularly gulls.’

raudsandberget-naturreservat-nat658fe15d.d: Raudsandberget Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Averøy municipality. It comprises an area by the Bremsnesfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. The use of bicycles, horses and carts, and riding off existing paths is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a coastal hazel forest site with its natural flora and fauna. Notable features include the presence of the white helleborine (Cephalanthera longifolia).’

mj-lvabotnen-naturreservat-nate7ea44c2.d: Mjølvabotnen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Rauma municipality. It comprises an area close to Åndalsnes. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the northernmost stands of ash forest in Western Norway, together with its natural flora and fauna.’ Ash dominates, but there are also grey alder, birch, willow, elm and hazel.

hagset-naturreservat-natf02f5bc4.d: Hagset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area on Otrøya facing Midfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an unusually varied and species-rich thermophilic forest site, including hazel, black alder and yew, together with its natural flora and fauna.’

sj-holt-naturreservat-nat50b3c221.d: Sjøholt Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ålesund municipality. It comprises an area near Sjøholt. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. The use of bicycles, horse-drawn carts and horse riding off existing roads is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area with a wide variety of thermophilic forest types and their natural flora and fauna’. The 2005 conservation plan describes the landscape as follows: ‘The reserve extends from bare mountain slopes, through scree slopes, to varied deciduous woodland. The landscape bears the marks of having been relatively open, but is now becoming overgrown with forest.’

batnfjords-ra-naturreservat-nat4f2e6ddb.d: Batnfjordsøra Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Gjemnes municipality. It comprises an area at the head of Batnfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the few remaining large gravel islands in the county where there are still relatively large areas of intact salt marshes of significant botanical and ornithological conservation interest.’ The area is a breeding ground for the oystercatcher, lapwing, redshank and black-headed gull. Grey herons, mallards, teals, eider ducks, common scoters and goldeneyes use the reserve in both summer and winter, whilst whooper swans and common goldeneyes have been recorded during the winter months.

riste-naturreservat-nat26dcfd39.d: Riste Nature Reserve comprises the island of Riste, off Kvamsøya in Sande municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to part of the area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area consists of a virtually untouched rocky island featuring, amongst other things, scree, wet heathland and salt marshes, as well as the surrounding marine area. Together with its natural flora and fauna, the area constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds, including the great cormorant, the common murre and the eider duck.”

osen-naturreservat-nat71de84db.d: Osen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area at the mouth of the River Oselva in Fannefjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river estuaries. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a landscape comprising salt marshes and tidal flats at the mouth of a protected watercourse with a largely intact ecosystem’. The 2015 management plan lists several bird species in the reserve: common shelduck, common sandpiper, redshank, whooper swan, common gull, dunlin, tufted duck, goosander, mallard, eider and crane. The whooper swan is an undesirable invasive species that has been observed breeding here.

havagane-naturreservat-nat1ca271fb.d: Havågane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ulstein municipality. It consists of a small area between County Road 653 and the sea. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve the remnants of the largest contiguous oak forest stand in Møre og Romsdal, together with its natural flora and fauna.’

ottem-naturreservat-natc25e2102.d: Ottem Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sunndal municipality. It comprises an area on the northern mountainside of Sunndalen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the largest sites of tall-herb grey alder forest in the county, as well as a smaller stand of thermophilic elm forest with its natural flora and fauna and all its natural ecological processes.’

oppd-lsstranda-naturreservat-nat3526b2e6.d: Oppdølsstranda Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sunndal municipality. It comprises an area on the north side of the Sunndalsfjord, just outside Sunndalsøra. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area containing threatened, rare and vulnerable natural features in the form of a large and largely untouched fjord valley with thermophilic vegetation in various forms and associated vegetation types up towards the mountains, together with the natural flora and fauna and all the natural ecological processes.”

knutsli-ya-naturreservat-nat266ca92f.d: Knutsliøya Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sunndal municipality. It comprises an area just east of Grøa at the bottom of the valley along the River Driva. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a lush forest area along the River Driva, featuring thermophilic vegetation and its natural flora and fauna’. Notable features include the area’s high density of cavity-nesting birds.

reitvagen-naturreservat-nat2a4c8d41.d: Reitvågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Heim municipality. It comprises an area at the innermost part of Skålvikfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an almost untouched salt marsh area as a typical site on a small bay. The site has clearly defined zones within the salt marshes and a good selection of brackish water plant communities.’

saltstein-kl-vningen-naturreservat-nat21.d: The Saltstein-Kløvningen Nature Reserve consists of countless skerries in a shallow stretch of sea at Hustadvika in the municipalities of Aukra and Ålesund. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited, with the exception of Saltsteinen. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The shallow-water area, with its many virtually untouched skerries and islets, and its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds, particularly the great cormorant.

kvamsetelva-naturreservat-nat22242bfb.d: Kvamsetelva Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Volda municipality. It comprises an area on the western side at the innermost part of Hjørundfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a site with thermophilic deciduous woodland and its natural flora and fauna. Of particular note is the thermophilic grey alder and elm forest.’

alstranda-naturreservat-nat399a026e.d: Alstranda Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Hareid and Ulstein. It comprises an area by the Vartdalsfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large, untouched deciduous forest of international significance, with its natural flora and fauna and all its natural ecological processes’. Of particular value is the area’s high biodiversity, which includes a number of rare plant and bird species.

myskjaurene-naturreservat-natd8afd6a0.d: Myskjaurene Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Haram municipality. It comprises an area on Haramsøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a coastal site with typical hazel thickets featuring thermophilic vegetation and its natural flora and fauna.’

berkneset-naturreservat-nate4d37dc6.d: Berkneset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Volda municipality. It comprises an area at Berkneset. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests/rich deciduous forests. The use of bicycles, horses and carts, and riding off existing paths is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the best-developed black alder forest sites in the county, with its natural flora and fauna.’

skorgeura-naturreservat-nat610b76af.d: Skorgeura Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ørsta municipality. It comprises an area at the mouth of the Skorgedalen valley, on the north side of the Ørstafjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a deciduous forest habitat with an unusually high diversity of native flora and fauna and all its natural ecological processes. Notable features include the area’s great diversity of plants and birds, and its significant value in terms of geology, science and nature experiences.”

grytahatlen-naturreservat-nat4c66bc9a.d: Grytahatlen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Haram municipality. It comprises an area by the Grytafjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests/rich deciduous forests. The use of bicycles, horses and carts, and riding off existing paths is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a small but well-developed oak forest site with its natural flora and fauna.’

sulesund-naturreservat-nat70e3da7e.d: Sulesund Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sula municipality. It comprises an area by the Sulafjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests/rich deciduous forests. The use of bicycles, horses and carts, and riding off existing roads is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a very well-developed black alder forest site with its natural flora and fauna.’

gjevenesstranda-naturreservat-nata80f1d4.d: Gjevenesstranda Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ørsta municipality. It comprises an area on the eastern side of Hjørundfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a virtually untouched fjord landscape with thermophilic forest vegetation, its natural flora and fauna, and all its natural ecological processes.’

svorkalia-naturreservat-nate72fdd74.d: Svorkalia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Surnadal and Rindal. It comprises an area near Folda. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests/rich deciduous forests. The use of bicycles, horses and carts, and riding off existing roads is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a typical elm forest in the inner part of the county, with its natural flora and fauna.’

tagdalen-naturreservat-nata321130d.d: Tågdalen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Surnadal municipality. It comprises an area in Nordmarka in Surnadal. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a mire area with an unusually rich flora, including many rare plant species. The site is of value as a special area of national importance.’

boksaspa-naturreservat-nat004a294d.d: Boksaspa Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Tingvoll municipality. It comprises an area on Aspøya by the Bergsøyfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve the world’s northernmost oak forest of any significant size, with its natural flora and fauna. Among its special features, the area is home to rare species of lichen and fungi.’

fj-rtoftneset-naturreservat-natec0c60d0.d: Fjørtoftneset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Haram municipality. It comprises an area at the north-westernmost tip of Fjørtofta. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a special natural area of varied and significant conservation interest. The mires are of value as a regional example of their type. In addition, Fjørtoftneset is an important breeding, wintering and migration site for seabirds. The coastal vegetation is varied and well-developed, and is of national conservation value.’ There is a field of burial mounds from the Iron Age on the headland. These are automatically protected as cultural heritage sites.

prestgardselva-naturreservat-nat69b147f0.d: Prestgardselva Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Surnadal municipality. It comprises an area between Surnadalsfjorden and Stangvikfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a very rich and well-developed hill mire landscape of value as a national type area.’

grip-naturreservat-nat8ff644a9.d: Grip Nature Reserve comprises an area near Grip in Kristiansund municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. There is a ban on access to land within the reserve from 1 May to 31 July inclusive. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The marine area, with its two small, virtually untouched islets and their naturally associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the great cormorant, eider, several species of gull, black guillemot, tern and Arctic skua.”

prestholmen-naturreservat-nat634efdd3.d: Prestholmen Nature Reserve comprises Prestholmen, situated at the innermost part of Langfjorden in Molde municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The area comprises one of the very few unspoilt open islets in the inner fjord regions of the county, together with the surrounding marine area and its naturally associated flora and fauna.

sveltingen-naturreservat-natf3853c9c.d: Sveltingen Nature Reserve consists of two islets just south of Ona in Ålesund municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area, including the skerries and surrounding marine area, together with the associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the great cormorant and the black guillemot.’

orholmen-gr-ningen-naturreservat-natd297.d: The Orholmen-Grøningen Nature Reserve consists of islets and skerries in a shallow stretch of sea off Gossa in Aukra municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The marine area, with its unspoilt, exposed islets, skerries and shallow waters, together with its naturally occurring flora and fauna, is a particularly attractive breeding site for terns.

r-ssholmen-skjela-oterholmen-naturreserv.d: The Røssholmen-Skjela-Oterholmen Nature Reserve comprises an area near Ona in Ålesund municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited, with the exception of Skjela and Røssholmen. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats’.

svetlingane-naturreservat-natd89481b3.d: Svetlingane Nature Reserve consists of a number of islets out at sea to the north of Haram municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of particular value for biodiversity. The group of untouched, weather-beaten skerries and the surrounding sea area facing the open sea, with its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitute an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the great cormorant, grey gull, black-backed gull, lesser black-backed gull and black guillemot.

vistdalsholmen-naturreservat-nat37b44746.d: The Vistdalsholmen Nature Reserve comprises Vistdalsholmen in Molde municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area is one of very few islets in the inner fjord regions of the county that is virtually untouched and which, with its open areas and rocky outcrops, surrounding marine area and naturally associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds, including the common gull and other gull species.”

einsetmyra-naturreservat-nateb08ea42.d: Einsetmyra Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Tingvoll municipality. It comprises an area by Langsetvågen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a small but well-developed raised bog area of conservation value as a national example of its type.’

ratvikvatnet-naturreservat-nat4b25acb9.d: Ratvikvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ålesund municipality. It comprises an area near Ratvikåsen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve is part of the wetland conservation plan. As long as there is open water, all access to the reserve is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Ratvikvatnet and the neighbouring Lerstadvatnet in the Lerstadvatnet Nature Reserve are of particular interest as breeding grounds for the little grebe. The species is critically endangered in Norway. According to the 2010 management plan, there were at that time 1 to 2 pairs breeding here each year.

tautra-vest-naturreservat-nata95f30e2.d: The Tautra West Nature Reserve comprises part of Tautra, along with a number of islets and skerries in Midfjorden in Molde municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of particular value for biodiversity’. The area is a virtually untouched part of Tautra, comprising damp heathland, rocky ridges and islets, as well as the surrounding coastal and marine areas.

husfjellet-naturreservat-nat7fabbbaf.d: Husfjellet Nature Reserve consists of a north-facing mountainside on Flemsøya in Haram municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the protected area by land is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The virtually untouched rock formation, characterised by its bird cliffs and its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding site for seabirds such as the grey gull, common gull, shag and fulmar.

lerstadvatnet-naturreservat-nat90c2431a.d: Lerstadvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ålesund municipality. It comprises an area in the Lerstad district of Ålesund. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. As long as there is open water, all access outside the marked paths and viewing points is prohibited within the reserve. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Lerstadvatnet and the nearby Ratvikvatnet in the Ratvikvatnet Nature Reserve are of particular interest as breeding grounds for the little grebe. The species is critically endangered in Norway. According to the 2010 management plan, there were at that time 2 to 3 pairs breeding here each year.

fe-ya-naturreservat-nat09a47c7d.d: Feøya Nature Reserve consists of a small island just off the village of Vestnes in Vestnes municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land within the protected area is prohibited, although there is, amongst other things, an exception allowing the landowner to collect up to 100 gull eggs. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats’.

storholmen-naturreservat-nat005b5149.d: The Storholmen Nature Reserve consists of three islets out at sea to the north-west of Vigra in Giske municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The area consists of three weather-beaten, virtually untouched islets with surrounding marine areas and the flora and fauna naturally associated with them.

masehamrane-naturreservat-nat7a6415b7.d: The Måsehamrane Nature Reserve consists of a mountainside on Lepsøya in Haram municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the protected area by land is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The area consists of virtually untouched steep mountain slopes with a ‘bird cliff’ character close to the sea, which, with its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding site for seabirds such as the grey gull, the common murre and the shag, amongst others.

gj-sundholmen-naturreservat-nat3a653e64.d: Gjøsundholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet and a few skerries between Vigra and the mainland. The reserve is situated in Haram municipality and was designated on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area consists of an undisturbed islet with surrounding skerries and marine areas, and with naturally occurring flora and fauna. The area constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the grey gull, the black-backed gull and the eider.’

erkna-naturreservat-nat22b54717.d: Erkna Nature Reserve consists of a small island west of Vigra in Giske municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats. The area consists of a virtually untouched island with beaches and rocky outcrops, as well as the surrounding sea and skerries.

langholmen-naturreservat-nat95aa0b83.d: Langholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet north of Vigra in Giske municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity’. The area consists of an unspoilt islet with lush vegetation and ponds, and the surrounding shores and sea area. Together with its natural flora and fauna, the area constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as gulls and kittiwakes.’

hustadvassdraget-naturreservat-nat6a1fe2.d: The Hustadvassdraget Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises Lake Frelsvatnet and an area around the Nørdre Hustadelva river. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. The area is used by wetland birds for breeding and foraging during migration. Species found here include ducks, waders and whooper swans.

eggholmen-naturreservat-nat35bc6377.d: Eggholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet off the coast of Flø in Ulstein municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land within the protected area is prohibited. The reserve is situated within the Flø wildlife sanctuary. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The unspoilt islet, with its lush vegetation, rocky outcrops, kelp beds and the surrounding marine areas, and the naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitute an important breeding ground for seabirds, including eider ducks, several species of gull and the black guillemot.”

kjepina-naturreservat-natbe68dfbc.d: The Kjepina Nature Reserve consists of an islet and a number of skerries in Grytafjorden in Haram municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats’.

s-tredalen-naturreservat-nat33df785c.d: Sætredalen Nature Reserve comprises an area on Valderøy in Giske municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the protected area by land is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area is a virtually untouched heather- and grass-covered valley leading down to a disused reservoir. The area, with its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding site for the grey gull and the black-backed gull.”

sandvikmyrane-naturreservat-nat1ca7e701.d: Sandvikmyrane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Aure municipality. It comprises an area at Sandvika, north-east of Tustna. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a representative coastal mire area of value as a regional type site’.

vegsundholmane-veibustholmen-naturreserv.d: The Vegsundholmane-Veibustholmen Nature Reserve consists of four islets and a few skerries in Flisfjorden in Ålesund municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The marine area, with its virtually untouched islets and skerries and the associated natural flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the common gull, the Arctic tern and the eider duck.”

seljebotsmyrane-naturreservat-nat2669900.d: Seljebotsmyrane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Fjord municipality. It consists of an area where the Nørdredalen valley splits. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a representative area of lowland mire for the region, which is of value as a typical habitat.’

muleneset-naturreservat-natdf41fa2a.d: Muleneset Nature Reserve comprises an area situated at the very tip facing the sea, on the north-western tip of Nerlandsøya in Herøy municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to the land is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity’. The area is a virtually untouched, steep terrain in the north-west of Nerlandsøya, which, together with the surrounding marine area and its naturally associated flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as, amongst others, the great cormorant, common murre, black guillemot and gulls.”

amsmyra-naturreservat-nat452b095d.d: Åmsmyra Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ørsta municipality. It comprises an area near Ørsta. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a raised bog of conservation value as a national type area. The presence of other mire and habitat types enhances its conservation value.’

r-dholmen-naturreservat-natb1cb366e.d: Rødholmen Nature Reserve consists of a group of islets and skerries off the coast of Flemsøya in Haram municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity and which contains threatened, rare and vulnerable natural habitats’.

langvatnet-naturreservat-nat9f229151.d: Langvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Tingvoll municipality. It comprises an area near Straumsnes Church. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. The reserve is a breeding ground for mallards and waders and is also used as a feeding ground by swans.

hj-rungdalsvatnet-naturreservat-nat5b915.d: Hjørungdalsvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hareid municipality. It comprises Lake Hjørungdalsvatnet and the surrounding area. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife.’

smagevatnet-naturreservat-nat06906b51.d: Smågevatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Aukra municipality. It comprises an area to the west of Gossa. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. From 1 April to 31 August inclusive, all access is prohibited within part of the reserve. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Smågevatnet has been fish-free, and this has provided good feeding conditions for birds such as diving ducks (for example, tufted duck, common scaup, velvet scoter, common goldeneye and common eider), dabbling ducks (for example, mallard, wigeon and teal), waders (such as the redshank) and the water rail.

hustadbukta-naturreservat-nat672667f6.d: Hustadbukta Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises an area by Hustadbukta where the two rivers, Sagelva and Hustadelva, flow into the bay. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the northernmost special sites for southern sand dunes with sand couch grass and sea rocket’. The 2012 management plan states that birds such as the great northern diver, red-throated loon, black-throated loon, horned grebe and red-necked grebe overwinter here. It also mentions, amongst others,

ksendals-ra-naturreservat-nat2dc1aacd.d: Øksendalsøra Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sunndal municipality. It comprises an area at the head of Øksendalsbukta, at the mouth of the Usma river. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river deltas. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is “to safeguard biodiversity and the ecological and morphological function of the river delta in one of the last remaining, largely untouched river deltas in the county.”

nys-tervatnet-naturreservat-nat8232dd01.d: Nysætervatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Ålesund and Vestnes. It comprises an area on Ørskogfjellet by the E39 between Sjøholt and Vestnes. The reserve is separated from the Måslia Nature Reserve by the E39. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife.’

sandsvagen-naturreservat-nat09bc5023.d: Sandsvågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sande municipality. It comprises an area near Sandshamn. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife.’

barlindneset-naturreservat-natc3497bb8.d: Barlindneset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve on the eastern side of Hjørundfjorden in Ørsta municipality in Møre og Romsdal, in the area between the farms of Nes and Molaupen. The nature reserve was established by royal decree on 13 October 2000. The nature reserve covers 1,400 daa. Barlindneset Nature Reserve is situated in the very steep outlying land belonging to the farms Molaupen, farm number 112, parcel numbers 1 and 2, in Ørsta, and Nes, farm number 112, parcel numbers 1 and 2, in Ørsta. Section 2 of the conservation order states the following: ‘The purpose of the conservation order is to safeguard a natural environment with a large and vital population of yew trees in Møre og Romsdal. The area contains a valuable mix of demanding broad-leaved forest species.’

aspasmyran-naturreservat-nat432a9c67.d: Aspåsmyran Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Gjemnes municipality. It consists of a marshland area west of Angvika in Tingvollfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, all access is prohibited. The Heggemsvatn/Holåvatnet Nature Reserve, which was designated at the same time, is situated nearby. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife.’ Goldeneye, crane, common snipe and green sandpiper have been recorded as breeding here.

lauvasen-naturreservat-natb560a3e4.d: Lauvåsen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Averøy municipality. It comprises an area near Kårvåg. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a large and well-developed mire area of value as a national example of its type.’

gl-svagen-naturreservat-natfb91c909.d: Gløsvågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Kristiansund, established on 27 May 1988 under the Wetlands Conservation Plan. It is situated in the Nordlandet district, north of Kvernberget Airport. The area is small but extremely diverse and boasts a rich variety of birdlife.

fr-neidet-naturreservat-nat161a5ea0.d: Fræneidet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises an area between Trolldalen and Børresdalen, on the isthmus between Malmefjorden and Eide. It encompasses a bog area at the bottom of the valley and extends up a mountainside to almost 500 metres above sea level. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an unusually varied mire area of conservation value as a national type area.’

orskjera-naturreservat-nat47c45498.d: Orskjera Nature Reserve consists of an archipelago area some distance out to sea on the border between the municipalities of Hustadvika and Averøy. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The exposed skerry area, with a number of untouched small islets and skerries, the surrounding sea and the associated flora and fauna, constitutes a very important breeding site for seabirds, particularly the great cormorant.

storeidet-naturreservat-nate616d405.d: Storeidet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sykkylven municipality. It comprises an area near Hundeidvik. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a varied mire area of value as a national example of its type’.

haver-ya-landskapsvernomrade-nat5b28eb3a.d: The Haverøya Landscape Conservation Area is a protected area in Smøla municipality where flora and fauna are protected. The vegetation is characterised by contiguous grazing land comprising heather moors, grass-rich natural pastures, bogs and wet heathland. There are also areas of bare rock. On Søre Krongelholmen, the vegetation is dominated by natural pastures such as silver grass meadows and meadows dominated by meadow foxtail. The heather moors are dominated by crowberry. The landscape conservation area boasts a remarkably high diversity of grassland fungi, totalling 39 species. Haverøya is an important breeding and foraging area for greylag geese. Various species of gulls breed here, and waders rest in the bay on Storhaverøya.

nesplassen-naturreservat-nata408af14.d: Nesplassen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Fjord Municipality. It comprises an area close to the centre of Stordal. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests/rich deciduous woodlands. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the best-developed ash forest sites in the county, with its natural flora and fauna’. Tree species growing here include ash, hazel, aspen, elm, grey alder, rowan, hawthorn, birch, pine and willow. Rare plants in the area include bird’s-nest fern, liquorice, large-leaved helleborine, mountain avens and vanilla orchid.

hostadvatnet-naturreservat-nat5cc95b55.d: Hostadvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises Lake Hostadvatnet and the surrounding area. The area was designated a protected area on 27 May 1988. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. From 1 April to 31 August inclusive, all access is prohibited within a section at the northern end of the reserve. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Birds use this as a breeding and foraging area during migration. Bird species found here include, amongst others, the horned grebe, water rail, corncrake, reed warbler, bluethroat, ruff, golden plover, lapwing and common snipe.

storevika-naturreservat-nat08f56692.d: Storevika Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sande municipality. It comprises an area in the south of Sandsøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve forms part of the wetland conservation plan. The nature reserve borders the Voksaholmane wildlife sanctuary, which was designated at the same time. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Among the birds recorded in the reserve are the black-tailed godwit, pintail, gadwall, common scoter, common eider, common tern, common gull, common sandpiper, grey gull, sand martin, Little Grebe, Eurasian Curlew, Gadwall, Teal, Turnstone, Marsh Harrier, Golden Plover, Little Stint, Arctic Skua and Redshank.

farstadbukta-naturreservat-natdc132a8f.d: Farstadbukta Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises an area around the mouth of the Farstadelva river. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a special site for southern sand dunes of high scientific value. The site is the world’s northernmost site of southern-type sand dunes.’

fugl-ya-naturreservat-nat18623841.d: Fugløya Nature Reserve comprises the island of Fugløya in Kristiansund municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve forms part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land is prohibited in large parts of the protected area. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The island, together with the surrounding islets and marine area, with their naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes a very important breeding site for seabirds, particularly eider ducks, common gulls and red-billed terns.”

kallset-naturreservat-nat5c25912f.d: Kallset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Surnadal and Heim. It comprises an area by the Trongfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for broad-leaved forests/rich deciduous forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the most species-rich elm-hazel forest sites in the county, with its natural flora and fauna and all its natural ecological processes.’

br-skjalia-naturreservat-nat5c15cdef.d: Brøskjalia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Surnadal municipality. It comprises an area by the Stangvikfjord where it meets the Breifjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for deciduous broad-leaved forests. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a highly species-rich and thermophilic deciduous forest site with its natural flora and fauna’. The conservation area is a thermophilic deciduous forest of the elm-lime type that is extremely species-rich. It contains elm, hazel, ash, black alder, hawthorn and grey alder. The area has previously been used as a firewood forest, for leaf litter collection and for grazing.

lang-yvagen-naturreservat-nat9462e903.d: Langøyvågen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It comprises an area on the island of Vågøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a typical area of salt marsh with great botanical diversity, where the salt marshes consist mainly of submerged, salt and brackish water marshes. The large stands of saltwort mean that the area is also a special site for this type of beach.’ There are cultural heritage sites within the reserve.

tj-rvagosen-naturreservat-nat51dce818.d: Tjørvågosen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Herøy municipality. It comprises an area near Tjørvåg. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a cove – the only one in outer Sunnmøre included in the conservation plan. The area is of value as a regional example of a type of landscape where a small coastal watercourse flows into a shallow bay, forming a gradual transition between the river and the sea.”

r-amyrane-naturreservat-nat4a05f40b.d: Røamyrane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area on the Skåla Peninsula. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large mire area with typical features and flora. The site is of value as a national type site.’

remerhornheiane-naturreservat-nate9f4931.d: Remerhornheiane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sykkylven municipality. It comprises an area to the south-west of Andestadvatnet. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a hill mire area of value as a national type site.’

bakkedalen-naturreservat-nat3d0597ec.d: Bakkedalen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Haram municipality. It comprises an area in the centre of Flemsøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve the largest, intact area of ground-covering mire in Møre og Romsdal. The site is of value as a national type area.’

korsbrekke-naturreservat-natabb64b14.d: Korsbrekke Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Stranda municipality. It comprises an area at Hellesylt, at the innermost part of Sunnylvsfjorden. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river deltas. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the only two remaining, partially intact river deltas deep within the Sunnmøre fjords, along with the associated biodiversity.’

h-gmyran-naturreservat-nat70ea752b.d: Høgmyran Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Surnadal municipality. It comprises an area between Andersvatnet, Geitøyvatnet and Krokvatnet. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a well-developed mire area of value as a regional example of its type.’

heggemsvatn-holavatnet-naturreservat-nat.d: The Heggemsvatn/Holåvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Gjemnes municipality. It comprises Heggemsvatnet, Holåvatnet and the areas surrounding and between them. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve forms part of the wetland conservation plan. The Aspåsmyran Nature Reserve, which was designated at the same time, is situated nearby. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. Birds that breed here include the green sandpiper, the common snipe, the goldeneye and the little curlew.

ristesundsanden-naturreservat-nat1aa5549.d: Ristesundsanden Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sande municipality. It comprises an area in the north of Kvamsøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a relatively intact dune area as a typical habitat for southern and thermophilic dune vegetation.’

molnes-naturreservat-nat6632e269.d: The Molnes Nature Reserve on Vigra was established in 2002. The reserve forms part of a conservation plan for coastal beaches and river deltas in Møre og Romsdal. The aim of the conservation area is to safeguard an area with a rare composition and a varied coastal landscape, including, amongst other things, calcium-demanding vegetation and several species of orchid.

r-stadtangen-naturreservat-nat6d8e4630.d: Ræstadtangen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area in the north of Otrøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river estuaries in Møre og Romsdal. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a special area that remains one of the finest salt marsh areas in the county, with a well-developed, large saltwater gravel beach, extensive salt marsh areas, a large back pool, meandering, partly pool-forming drainage, and one of the few recorded communities of tufted hairgrass in the county.’ Thirty-eight different plant species have been recorded here. Rare species found here include tufted hairgrass, small sea grass and saltwort.

soln-rvika-naturreservat-nat07341581.d: Solnørvika Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Ålesund municipality. It comprises an area at the innermost part of Solnørvika, at the mouth of the Solnørelva river. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a typical site for a wave-swept beach at the mouth of a nationally protected watercourse in the central part of Sunnmøre.’

tromskjera-mannskjera-naturreservat-natf.d: The Tromskjera-Mannskjera Nature Reserve consists of an archipelago area on the border between the municipalities of Hustadvika and Averøy. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010 (approved on 28 May 2010) as one of 36 reserves in Møre og Romsdal. The reserve is part of the seabird conservation plan. From 1 May to 31 July inclusive, access to land within the protected area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to safeguard an area of particular value for biodiversity. The area, with its undisturbed shores and surrounding marine environment, together with its naturally occurring flora and fauna, constitutes an important breeding ground for seabirds such as the common gull and the black-backed gull.”

tresfjorden-naturreservat-nat3f20a053.d: Tresfjorden Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Vestnes municipality. It consists of a river delta at the bottom of Tresfjorden, around the mouth of the River Tressa. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for seashores and river deltas. Cycling and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve one of the largest remaining and relatively untouched river deltas in the county, where the beach area is built up around a central river course’. The area was used as hay meadow until the 1960s–1970s. Since then, horses have grazed here, and occasionally sheep. A total of 83 plant species have been recorded.

hjertvika-naturreservat-nate8efe519.d: Hjertvika Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Aukra municipality. It comprises an area around a sandy beach south of Gossa. The area was designated a nature reserve on 8 November 2002. The reserve is part of the conservation plan for seashores and river mouths. Cycling and horse riding off existing paths are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve the least disturbed sand dune site in Romsdal, which is also the northernmost in Europe to feature marram grass and sand couch in any significant quantity.’

gule-stavikmyrane-naturreservat-nat0e490.d: The Gule-/Stavikmyrane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hustadvika municipality. It consists of a large bog landscape near Bud. The area was designated a nature reserve on 13 December 1996. The reserve is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a central part of one of the country’s largest mire landscapes. The site is of value as a national type area.’

kjerringvatnet-naturreservat-nat1c5c9eb5.d: Kjerringvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Molde municipality. It comprises an area on Otrøya. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 May 1988. The reserve is part of the wetland conservation plan. From 1 April to 31 August inclusive, all access is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with its associated plant communities, birdlife and other wildlife’. The reserve is a breeding ground for the coot, and possibly also for the pintail, gadwall and shoveler.

kallskaret-naturreservat-nat0c89fccb.d: Kallskaret Nature Reserve is a nature reserve situated between Herdalen and Tafjord in Fjord municipality (formerly Norddal municipality). The reserve was established on 16 November 1984 to protect the eclogite rock formation, which alternates with other rock types in this area. The protected area covers approximately 900 dekar and lies at an altitude of around 950 metres above sea level. The landscape is characterised by pillars of olivine up to two metres high, and there is sparse vegetation on the desert-like reddish-yellow-brown ground. The reserve is completely surrounded by the Geiranger-Herdalen Landscape Conservation Area and lies entirely within the Western Norwegian Fjord Landscape World Heritage Site.

hovsflesa-naturreservat-nat9c23b957.d: Hovsflesa Nature Reserve is situated in Vågan municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve consists of a group of small, barren islets out at sea to the north-west of Gimsøya. The area covers 670 dekar, of which 667 dekar is marine area. The area is protected to safeguard a nationally important/potentially important breeding site for the northern gannet and a cormorant colony of great regional value.

borgv-ret-landskapsvernomrade-nat00e61ae.d: The Borgværet Landscape Conservation Area was established in 2002 and is situated in Vestvågøy municipality in Nordland. The landscape conservation area is a wildlife sanctuary, covers an area of 1,418 dekar (of which 587 dekar is marine area) and is protected on account of its distinctive cultural and natural landscape. The Borgværet Nature Reserve surrounds the entire landscape conservation area.

r-stlandet-naturreservat-nat4b6d0fc5.d: Røstlandet Nature Reserve is situated on the island of Røstlandet in Røst municipality, Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 920 dekar, of which 250 dekar is land. The area is protected to preserve an important wetland area with its natural vegetation and wildlife, particularly due to the area’s significance as a migration and breeding site for wetland birds, as well as its rich and distinctive flora.

svellingsflaket-landskapsvernomrade-nat2.d: The Svellingsflaket Landscape Conservation Area is situated in the municipalities of Lødingen and Vågan in Nordland. The area is a wildlife sanctuary; it was established in 2002 and covers 127,616 dekar, of which 117,190 dekar is marine area. The landscape conservation area was established on account of its cultural landscape and associated botany, geology and wildlife.

h-ljanmyra-naturreservat-nat1650e2f0.d: Høljanmyra Nature Reserve is situated in Øksnes municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve comprises a bog area between Klo and Langnes on Langøya. The area covers 1,100 dekar. It has been designated a nature reserve to preserve a representative, unspoilt bog area in Vesterålen, particularly with regard to the flora and the interesting types of bog found there.

anda-naturreservat-natc8854be4.d: Anda Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and Ramsar site in Øksnes municipality in Nordland. The reserve was established to ‘preserve a valuable coastal area, with its naturally associated flora and fauna. Of particular significance is the area’s value as a breeding ground for a number of auks and other seabird species’. The area lies approximately 5 km north of the northern tip of Langøya and west of Andøya, and comprises the island of Anden, with Anda Lighthouse, and a few small islets. The nature reserve covers 525 dekar, of which 359 dekar is sea area. The area is protected to preserve a seabird colony of national conservation importance, home to puffins, auks and kittiwakes. Furthermore, shags, grey gulls, black-backed gulls and kittiwakes also breed there in considerable numbers.

grunnfjorden-naturreservat-nata0457660.d: Grunnfjorden Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and Ramsar site in Øksnes municipality in Nordland. The reserve was established to ‘preserve an important wetland area with its naturally occurring vegetation and wildlife. It is particularly important to safeguard the wetland area’s vital importance for wetland birds throughout the year, as well as to preserve a botanically valuable salt marsh area.’ The area comprises Grunnfjorden, a marshland area on Langøya and part of Gisløya. The area covers 17,724 dekar, of which 7,500 dekar is land, 500 dekar is freshwater and 6,700 dekar is marine area.

selnesvatnet-naturreservat-nat88c9acbe.d: Selnesvatnet Nature Reserve is situated in Sortland municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve encompasses Selnesvatnet, west of Frøskeland on Langøya. The area covers 440 dekar, of which 155 dekar is land and 285 dekar is freshwater. The area is protected to preserve an important wetland area with its naturally associated vegetation and wildlife, particularly in view of its rich and interesting birdlife.

st-nyksund-naturreservat-natc73906d0.d: The Stø/Nyksund Nature Reserve is situated in Øksnes municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve comprises several small islands and islets off Langøya, between Stø and Nyksund. The area covers 4,803 dekar, of which 4,433 dekar is marine area. The area is protected to safeguard an important breeding ground for seabirds and harbour seals.
