strengivatnet-naturreservat-nate936728f.d: The Strengivatnet Nature Reserve is situated on the south-western shore of Lake Strengivatnet in Brønnøy municipality, Nordland. The aim of the conservation area is to protect a large area of boreal rainforest containing what is probably the richest remaining population of spruce felt lichen in Europe. A number of other Red Listed lichen species are also found here. The conservation area does not prevent reindeer herding from taking place in the area.

elsfjorden-naturreservat-natb6c082ff.d: Elsfjorden Nature Reserve is situated on the western side of Elsfjorden in the municipalities of Vefsn and Hemnes in Nordland. The nature reserve covers 11,150 dekar. The area has been protected to preserve a virtually untouched forest area as an ecosystem, with all its natural flora and fauna.

husbymarka-naturreservat-natab84a417.d: Husbymarka Nature Reserve is situated in the south-west of the island of Tomma in Nesna municipality, Nordland, approximately one kilometre north of the hamlet of Husby, on a slope leading up towards Breitinden. The nature reserve covers a total area of 325 dekar, of which 296 daa consists of deciduous, coniferous and mixed woodland. Within the area there are a total of twelve different species of trees and shrubs, as well as common vegetation and associated fauna. The purpose of the conservation is to preserve the only significant population of the rare narrow-leaved alder, which reaches its northern limit here and, globally, is found only in a few locations in Sogn og Fjordane. This makes Husbymarka invaluable from a scientific perspective.

bjortj-nnlimyrene-naturreservat-nat9bb69.d: The Bjortjønnlimyrene Nature Reserve is situated in Grane municipality in Nordland. The area is situated a few kilometres north of Majavatn. The nature reserve covers 4,300 dekar. The area is protected to preserve a wetland area with interesting types of bog and a rich and varied birdlife.

ostj-nna-naturreservat-nat6d86b147.d: Ostjønna Nature Reserve is situated on the island of Tjøtta in Alstahaug municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve encompasses Ostjønna, right next to the village of Tjøtta. The area covers 80 dekar, of which 45 dekar is land and 35 dekar is freshwater. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve a particularly productive brackish water lake of great regional conservation value, and to protect the associated birdlife.

skittenskarvholman-naturreservat-natc94e.d: Skittenskarvholman Nature Reserve is situated in Værøy municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve encompasses Skittenskarvholman, north-west of the island of Mosken. The area covers 56 dekar, of which 50 dekar is marine area. The area is protected to safeguard an important breeding ground for great cormorants, as well as a potential breeding site for gannets.

muddv-ret-fuglefredningsomrade-nateb883e.d: The Muddværet Bird Sanctuary is situated in Vega municipality in Nordland. The area covers 9,586 dekar, of which 7,547 dekar is marine area. The bird sanctuary was established to protect an important breeding ground for seabirds. The area is situated within the Vega World Heritage Site.

myrnesset-naturreservat-nat41753f77.d: Myrnesset Nature Reserve is situated by Lake Soløyvatnet in Bodø municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 220 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve a diverse complex of mires in the lowland areas of Nordland.

mannfjordbotn-naturreservat-nat4302f8cf.d: Mannfjordbotn Nature Reserve is situated at the head of Mannfjorden in Hamarøy municipality in Nordland. The reserve lies just south-east of the depopulated village of Mannfjorden, and approximately six kilometres north-west of the national border with Sweden. The nature reserve covers a total area of 9,742 dekar, consisting mainly of exposed rock, coniferous and deciduous woodland, and water bodies, of which the 790 daa lake Storvatnet is the largest. There are a number of different vegetation types within the nature reserve: blueberry-pine forest; grey moss-lichen-pine forest; mosaic-patterned heather-bilberry-pine forest, pine bog forest, heather moorland, small-fern birch forest, and bilberry-cowberry birch forest. Individual trees in the old pine forest have been dated to approximately 450 years old.

sagvassdalen-naturreservat-natb83ea4a4.d: The Sagvassdalen Nature Reserve is situated in the southernmost part of Hamarøy in Nordland, roughly between Kråkmotinden (Skilggátjåhkkå) to the west and Sluŋkajávrre to the east, with Lake Rekvatnet (Goajvojávrre) to the north and the municipal boundary with Sørfold to the south. The nature reserve was established as an extension of the former Golleriida reserve and covers a total area of 18,466 dekar, of which 2,731 dekar is productive forest, making it the largest nature reserve in Hamarøy. The reserve comprises a large, well-defined valley with mature pine forest, patches of pine forest on glacial river sediments, large areas of rich birch forest and a well-developed floodplain forest.

b-p-la-naturreservat-nat6ac4973b.d: The Bøpøla Nature Reserve is situated south of Berg in Sømna municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers 148 dekar, of which 62 dekar is land area. The area has been designated a protected area to preserve an important wetland.

indreholmen-lyngv-ret-naturreservat-nat1.d: The Indreholmen/Lyngværet Nature Reserve is situated in Herøy municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve comprises a large area of small islands to the west of Gåsvær. The area covers 25,540 dekar, of which 24,070 dekar is marine area. The area is protected to safeguard an important breeding ground for seabirds.

hammer-naturreservat-natdc2aa121.d: Hammerø Nature Reserve is situated approximately five kilometres south-east of the village of Nesna in Nordland, in a south-facing valley between the Hammarøya farm and the summit of Hammarøyfjellet. The nature reserve covers a total area of 98 dekar, of which 74 daa consists of deciduous, coniferous and mixed woodland. There are also patches of bare rock in places. The area is dominated by a generally dense and lush birch and elm forest, with elements of typical coastal and mountain vegetation. The purpose of the conservation is to preserve the largest stand of elm trees in Nesna, and one of the largest in the northern part of Helgeland.

kjeggen-naturreservat-natcedc815e.d: Kjeggen Nature Reserve is situated in Saltdal municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve comprises a small area with two different pine forests just north of Kristendalnes, on the eastern side of the Saltdal valley. The area covers 290 dekar. The area is protected to preserve one of the few remaining, relatively undisturbed, compact heather-pine forests on glaciofluvial deposits in the lowlands, and also to preserve a small stand of particularly large pine trees.

gr-nlidalen-naturreservat-nat0c245641.d: Grønlidalen Nature Reserve is situated on the south-western shore of Lake Sausvatnet in Brønnøy municipality, Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 505 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve and protect a stretch of boreal rainforest.

stormyra-naturreservat-nat349ebf29.d: Stormyra Nature Reserve is situated on the northern shore of Nedre Fiplingvatnet in Grane municipality, Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 1,270 dekar. The area is protected to preserve an important wetland area with its associated flora and fauna, in view of the rich variety of bog types and the interesting birdlife.

hopvasslia-naturreservat-nat0941312d.d: Hopvasslia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Steigen municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve protects a very diverse deciduous forest. It is situated on the north-eastern shore of Lake Hopvatnet and covers an area of 567 dekar.

bekkenesholmen-naturreservat-nat7dbe1907.d: Bekkenesholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet at the mouth of Tysfjorden. The nature reserve is situated north-west of Skarberget and east of Korsnes in Narvik municipality in Nordland, and covers an area of 435 dekar. The islet has a sparse, stunted and patchy stand of coastal pine on a bedrock of granite and granodiorite. Bekkenesholmen was protected by royal decree on 24 February 1928. This resolution did not specify the form of protection, but the term ‘national park’ has previously been used. The 2000 conservation regulations designate its status as a nature reserve. Bekkenesholmen has also been regarded by some as Norway’s first nature reserve, but Stange Nature Reserve was designated five years earlier.

eidvatnet-naturreservat-nat1ef1f0f3.d: Eidvatnet Nature Reserve is situated in Bindal municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve encompasses the catchment area around Eidvatnet. It was first designated as a nature reserve on 31 August 2001, covering an area of 19,111 dekar, and was extended on 22 June 2018 to 22,064.6 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve and safeguard an area of boreal rainforest.

teisdalen-naturreservat-nat377f0160.d: Teisdalen Nature Reserve is situated in Sømna municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 221 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve an exceptionally lush and diverse deciduous forest that has not been subject to significant logging.

osen-sandv-ret-naturreservat-nata03bffc0.d: The Osen/Sandværet Nature Reserve is situated in Ballangen municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 9,060 dekar, of which 6,014 dekar is water. The area has been designated a nature reserve to protect an area of great botanical value along the seashore, which is also important as a breeding ground for seabirds.

brunv-r-naturreservat-nat6a1314c4.d: Brunvær Nature Reserve is situated north of Engeløya, facing the Vestfjord, in Steigen, and is the northernmost of a series of coastal islets that begin in Nord-Trøndelag. Flatøya, which is the largest of the islands in the nature reserve, is actually four large, and a number of smaller, low rocky outcrops that are connected at low tide. Here there are coves and sounds with gravel, sand, silt and lush seaweed banks, with salt marshes at the innermost parts. The area has been inhabited and still bears some traces of farming. There are also the remains of a boathouse and a fence. The purpose of the conservation order is ‘to safeguard a valuable coastal area, with its naturally associated flora and fauna’.

holmvassdalen-naturreservat-nat04630303.d: Holmvassdalen Nature Reserve is situated in Grane municipality in Nordland. The area lies to the west of the E6, 25–30 km south of Trofors, and to the west of Store Svenningvatn, Kjerringvatn, Sefrivatn and Lille Majavatn. The reserve was established by the King in Council on 19 December 2008. The area was designated a nature reserve to preserve a virtually untouched natural area with its biological diversity in the form of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes. The valley contains relatively large areas of dense old-growth spruce forest on calcareous soil, and features a high proportion of rich vegetation types and a number of interesting occurrences of lichens, fungi, vascular plants and birds.

laksagaosen-naturreservat-natc41bc892.d: The Laksågaosen Nature Reserve is situated at the innermost part of Nordfjorden in Sørfold municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 158 dekar, of which 74 dekar is water. The area has been protected to preserve a valuable coastal area, with rare types of vegetation and the wildlife naturally associated with it.

drevjaleira-naturreservat-natb32ed307.d: The Drevjaleira Nature Reserve is situated at the mouth of the River Drevjo in Vefsn municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers 1,054 dekar, of which 1,020 dekar is water. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve the most important part of the only remaining wetland area along the Vefsnfjord.

storhaugen-naturreservat-natfe6b17e6.d: Storhaugen Nature Reserve is situated approximately 2 km south-west of Hommelstø in Brønnøy municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 211 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve and safeguard a boreal rainforest with all its species and ecological processes.

skansen-yra-naturreservat-natff91d792.d: Skansenøyra Nature Reserve is situated near Rognan in Saltdal municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve encompasses a delta area at the mouth of the Saltdalselva river where it flows into the Saltdalsfjord. The area covers 208 dekar, of which 15 dekar is land. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve the most unspoilt part of a threatened wetland type of great regional conservation value, particularly due to its role in supporting the site’s rich and varied birdlife and the area’s importance as a destination for excursions.

trolldalsvatnet-naturreservat-natf1739c7.d: The Trolldalsvatnet Nature Reserve is situated in Sørfold municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 140 dekar, of which 20 dekar is water. The area is protected to preserve a diverse range of bogs and wetlands, along with their associated flora and fauna.

skjelstad-naturreservat-nat8ca303c3.d: Skjelstad Nature Reserve is situated at Skjelstad in Bodø municipality in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 400 dekar, of which 230 dekar is water. The area has been designated a nature reserve to protect a valuable coastal area with its naturally associated flora and fauna.

tiurhaugen-naturreservat-nat210e11dc.d: Tiurhaugen Nature Reserve is situated approximately 5 km west of Storforshei in the municipality of Rana in Nordland. The nature reserve covers an area of 1,487 dekar. The area has been designated a nature reserve to preserve a relatively small area of coniferous forest, which in places has the character of primeval forest.

gr-ntj-nnan-naturreservat-nat1c5001f4.d: Grøntjønnan Nature Reserve comprises an area within Forollhogna National Park on both sides of the River Ya. The nature reserve is situated in Tynset municipality. It was designated on 18 December 1981 and forms part of the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area in its natural state and to protect the vegetation, the particularly rich and interesting birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area.’ The 2003 management plan describes the wildlife as follows: ‘The alternation between open water, marshes and bogs, willow thickets and areas of firm ground provides the basis for a rich and varied wildlife. Grøntjønnan is an important breeding ground for ducks and waders.

kolasen-naturreservat-nat8c018950.d: Kolåsen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Snåsa municipality. It comprises an area north-east of Lake Snåsavannet, within the winter grazing grounds of the Tjåehkeren sijte (Eastern Namdal reindeer grazing district). The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited outside the existing roads and paths shown in the management plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of old and largely undisturbed forest which, through its habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes, is of particular importance for biodiversity, particularly in relation to calcareous forests, with the demanding species associated with this category, as well as old-growth forest undergoing natural dynamics.”

ytre-brosmflesa-biotopvernomrade-nat8b6f.d: Ytre Brosmflesa Biotope Reserve is a biotope reserve and a Ramsar site in Nærøysund municipality in Trøndelag. The area was designated to ‘safeguard an important breeding ground for seabirds’, as part of a wider conservation plan in 2003. The conservation area comprises the islet of Brosmflesin and the surrounding waters. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of ten sub-areas within the Vest-Vikna coastal landscape.

vinnan-og-velvangen-fuglefredningsomrade.d: The Vinnan and Velvangen Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Stjørdal municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important intertidal and shallow-water area’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar site. The area comprises approximately 3 km of shoreline and intertidal zones, as well as shallow-water areas extending up to 1 km from the shoreline. The adjacent land area consists mainly of agricultural landscape. A total of 134 different species have been recorded here, and Vinge-Velvang is probably the fjord’s most important single site for eider, common scoter and long-tailed duck.

bingsholmsrasa-fuglefredningsomrade-nat5.d: The Bingsholmsråsa Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary situated at the far end of Skråfjorden in Åfjord municipality in Trøndelag, in the sound between Tårnes and Lauvøya. It is protected to ‘preserve a rich and interesting bird life, and to safeguard an important migration and wintering area for waterbirds’. When the nature reserve was established, it was, alongside the Ørland wetland system, the only site of its kind in the county.

lundleiret-fuglefredningsomrade-nat0fbcc.d: The Lundleiret Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Steinkjer municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important area comprising foreshore, land and shallow waters, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar site. This is a mudflat, approximately 2 km west of Steinkjer town centre, and bordering the Skåtangen recreational area. Off the coast of the mudflat area lie the islets of Gluggen and Loaskjæret. Lundleiret is an important feeding ground for gulls, waders and ducks. 134 species have been recorded. Gluggen is an important breeding site, with a varying species composition.

ferjlia-naturreservat-nat08e5007a.d: Ferjlia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the Fosen Mountains, in the north-west of Steinkjer municipality. It comprises an area surrounding the western part of Langvatnet and stretches from Bjørnaheia in the north to Langvassheia in the south. The reserve is situated in the Fosen reindeer grazing district. The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan.

sklinna-naturreservat-natadfd6495.d: Sklinna Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and Ramsar site in Leka municipality in Trøndelag. The reserve was established in 2003 ‘to preserve a distinctive island and archipelago area at the outer reaches of the Namdal coast, where botanical, zoological and geological features, both on land and at sea, contribute to the area’s unique character. The area is of great natural scientific value. It is of particular value as a breeding habitat for a number of seabird species, including the auks’. The Sklinna archipelago lies approximately 20 west of the island of Leka. Sklinna Lighthouse is situated here, and the fishing settlement had year-round residents until around 1900, after which it continued to be used as a fishing settlement.

r-st-ya-naturreservat-nat06c6acae.d: The Røstøya Nature Reserve comprises Røstøya in Heim municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 1 August 2010. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding off existing roads are prohibited. The reserve neighbours the Soløya Nature Reserve. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a coniferous forest area that is typical of the habitat type in the region.’

finntj-nndalen-naturreservat-nat832f24d3.d: The Finntjønndalen Nature Reserve is situated on the western side of Namdalen, in the very north of Grong municipality. The area consists of a valley with spruce forest rising up towards the bare mountain. The forest bears clear signs of past selective felling and has not yet recovered. As a result, there is a scarcity of windfall and deadwood. Blueberry spruce forest is common, but there are also tall-herb spruce forests with rich flora in calcareous areas. Six Red List species have been recorded in the area, including the river mussel in the Finntjønndalselva river. The flora and fauna are protected against damage and destruction. Motorised traffic is prohibited. Cycling and horse riding are also illegal outside existing paths.

olsengelva-naturreservat-natf58c67b8.d: Olsengelva Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Namsos municipality. It comprises an area east of Løgnin, within the winter grazing area of the Tjåehkeren sijte (Eastern Namdal reindeer grazing district). The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited outside existing roads and paths shown in the management plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a varied area of old and largely undisturbed forest’.

alnes-fuglefredningsomrade-nat3f971e79.d: The Alnes Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Levanger municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important area comprising tidal flats, land and shallow waters, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar site. Alnesfjæra is approximately 2.5 km long and lies north-east of Fiborgtangen (where Norske Skog Skogn is located) and west of Alstadhaug Church. The shore is surrounded by a belt of pebbles and farmland. Alnesfjæra’s most important function is during migration, particularly the autumn migration. The most common wetland birds occur in good numbers.

folldalen-og-lonskogen-naturreservat-nat.d: The Folldalen and Lonskogen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Høylandet municipality. It comprises an area around Folldalen, within the boundaries of the Åarjel-Njaarken sijte (Vestre Namdal reindeer grazing district). The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017 and extended on 16 December 2022 from approximately 12,685 dekar to approximately 15,113 dekar. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited off existing roads and paths. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a varied area of old and largely undisturbed forest, which, with its diversity of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes, is of particular importance for biodiversity.’

finntj-nnin-naturreservat-natb17e7001.d: Finntjønnin Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Overhalla municipality. It comprises areas within Finnfjellet. The area was first designated as a nature reserve on 16 December 2011 and extended on 21 June 2024. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Motorised traffic on land and water is prohibited, including the landing and take-off of aircraft. Cycling is prohibited outside existing paths. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area representing a specific type of natural environment in the form of mature, largely undisturbed old-growth forest undergoing natural dynamics, comprising the habitat types tall-herb forest, rich deciduous forest in the form of elm-lime forest, and rich and moist large-fern forest.”

rdalen-naturreservat-nat591ae586.d: Ørdalen Nature Reserve is situated on the eastern side of Skarnsundet in Inderøy municipality, Trøndelag. The area was designated a nature reserve in 1992. The purpose of the protection is to preserve a coniferous forest area that has been little affected by human activity and which has distinctive flora. The nature reserve extends for 1.7 km from Noremsflata in the north to Olberga in the south. From an elevation of approximately 190 metres above sea level north of the Ørdalen farm, the protected area slopes steeply down towards Skarnsundet. The area is situated in the lowland region of Trøndelag. The vegetation consists partly of heat-loving and nutrient-demanding species. Coniferous forest dominates, but there are patches of calcareous grassland with elm and hazel, as well as heat-loving herbs such as bluebell and mountain mint.

simle-naturreservat-natb35b60af.d: Simle Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Nærøysund municipality in Trøndelag. It covers an area of 41.77 km² and was established in 2010. The purpose of the reserve is to preserve a virtually untouched area of natural woodland. The area is large and relatively undisturbed, comprising low-lying coastal woodland of many different types, and is particularly important for biodiversity, with a wide variety of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes. There has previously been scattered settlement and forestry activity in the area, but large parts remain largely undisturbed.

ho-ya-naturreservat-nat7dbd3508.d: Hoøya Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Beitstadfjorden, north-east of Skarnsundet in Inderøy municipality, Trøndelag. The area was designated a nature reserve in 2003. The purpose of the protection is to preserve an island and its surrounding marine areas, with their natural flora and fauna, in an area otherwise characterised by high levels of human activity. Hoøya is of particular value as a breeding ground for seabirds. The island is hilly. On the steep, inaccessible slope from the summit (45.6 metres above sea level) down to the sea on the western side, grey gulls breed, giving the island the character of a bird cliff. The island is an important eider duck site and a key breeding area for grey gulls and black-backed gulls in Trondheimsfjorden.

smavollen-naturreservat-nat55ba8e16.d: Småvollen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Sunndal and Oppdal. It comprises an area to the east of Gjøra. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 June 2003. The reserve forms part of the conservation plan for deciduous forests and rich deciduous woodlands. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and riding off existing roads are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a floristically interesting elm forest site in the inner part of Sunndalen, with its natural flora and fauna.’

lundselvoset-naturreservat-nat5c594962.d: Lundselvoset Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and Ramsar site on the eastern shore of Leksdalsvatnet in Verdal municipality, Trøndelag, near County Road 759. The reserve was established to preserve ‘an important wetland area with vegetation, birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area’. The lake is a lowland lake with several vegetation-rich bays, shallow areas and a river delta. The bays are characterised by common reed and common bulrush vegetation. The shoreline provides good foraging grounds for waterbirds such as the pink-footed goose. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of three sub-areas within the Innherred freshwater system.

rinnleiret-naturreservat-natdc2e20a7.d: Rinnleiret Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Levanger and Verdal in Trøndelag. The area is important as a salt marsh, wetland, cultural landscape and outdoor recreation area, and is classified as an international Ramsar site. The area forms part of a larger delta region situated in the municipalities of Levanger and Verdal, and the protected area covers 2.168 km², including approximately 1.2 km² of groundwater areas. The site is also one of the largest remaining delta areas in Norway with predominantly salt marsh vegetation. As a bird habitat, it is important to view this in the context of the other intertidal areas in Trondheimsfjorden. 130 different plant species have been recorded here, including the two extremely rare species, the tufted sedge and the small water-crowfoot.

altskardet-naturreservat-natafd0633b.d: Altskardet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Namsos municipality. It consists of a steep, wooded hillside to the south-west of Altvatnet. It is situated in the Fosen reindeer grazing district. The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited outside the existing roads and paths shown in the management plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a varied area of old and largely undisturbed forest’.

vikanbukta-fuglefredningsomrade-nat1532d.d: The Vikanbukta Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Stjørdal municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2008. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar Site. Vikanbukta lies between Stjørdal harbour to the east and Kleivan to the west. At low tide, a 100–200-metre-wide mud and sand flat is exposed along the approximately 2,000-metre-long shoreline. The area is of greatest value as a resting place for wetland birds during their spring and autumn migrations.

lyngas-lysgard-fuglefredningsomrade-nat4.d: The Lyngås-Lysgård Bird Sanctuary is a biotope conservation area (wildlife sanctuary) and a Ramsar site on the eastern shore of Leksdalsvatnet in Verdal municipality in Trøndelag, just north of Stiklestad. The reserve was established to preserve ‘the rich birdlife and the birds’ habitats in the area, particularly in connection with the spring and autumn migrations’. The lake is a lowland lake with several vegetation-rich bays, shallow areas and a river delta. The bays are characterised by common reed and common bulrush vegetation. The shoreline provides good foraging grounds for waterbirds such as the pink-footed goose. There are two protected areas on the lake: this one and the Lundselvoset Nature Reserve. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of three sub-areas within the Innherred freshwater system.

eidsbotn-fuglefredningsomrade-nat356ec73.d: The Eidsbotn Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Levanger municipality, Nord-Trøndelag. Eidsbotn is a shallow fjord basin to the west of the E6, south of the Alti Magneten shopping centre and Levanger town centre, which is connected to Trondheimsfjorden via Levangersundet. The area forms part of the Trondheimsfjorden wetland system and has Ramsar status. The area was designated a nature reserve in 1984 to protect a wetland of great importance to birdlife: as a resting place for migratory birds, and as a moulting and wintering area for ducks.

aldgarden-naturreservat-nat8418094c.d: The Aldgården Nature Reserve consists of an area of islands and skerries out at sea, 8 km from the mainland in Namsos municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 19 December 2003 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 15 July inclusive, access to land within the conservation area is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area of islands and skerries, together with the naturally associated flora and fauna. Among other things, the area is important for the common eider, and as a moulting, foraging and wintering area for seabirds. Aldgården is of particular value as a breeding ground for seabirds.”

tronflesa-biotopvernomrade-nate2600216.d: Tronflesa Biotope Reserve is a biotope reserve and a Ramsar site in Nærøysund municipality in Trøndelag. The area was designated to ‘safeguard an important breeding ground for seabirds’ as part of a wider conservation plan in 2003. The conservation area consists of a number of islets and the surrounding waters. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of ten sub-areas within the Vest-Vikna coastal landscape.

kammen-og-kalddalen-naturreservat-nat41c.d: The Kammen and Kalddalen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Inderøy and Indre Fosen in Trøndelag. It comprises an area by the Trondheim Fjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited outside the existing paths and roads shown in the management plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a varied area of old and largely undisturbed forest’. With its diversity of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes, the area is of particular importance for biodiversity, especially in relation to southern boreal mixed forest and old-growth forest undergoing natural dynamics.

tekssj-en-naturreservat-nata7babc65.d: Tekssjøen Nature Reserve is a nature conservation area in Åfjord municipality in Trøndelag, at the easternmost end of Storddalen. It is a particularly large area of old-growth forest with primeval forest characteristics, and was designated a nature reserve as part of efforts to preserve untouched forest areas. The reserve lies at an altitude of 280–572 metres above sea level along the Stordalselva, Finndalselva and Reinsjøelva rivers, between Skurvseteren, Finndalen and Nordre Reinsjøen. The protected area covers 24,010 dekar and features elements of boreal rainforest.

hammervatnet-naturreservat-nat40924526.d: Hammervatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and Ramsar site in Levanger municipality in Trøndelag. The reserve was established to preserve ‘an important wetland area with vegetation, birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area’. The nature reserve encompasses the eastern part of the lake; along the shore here, there is a swamp forest of alder and a mixed forest with wayfaring tree. Hammervatnet is situated near the E6 in Åsen (Levanger), in an area rich in rock formations and marine deposits, and is affected by runoff from extensive agricultural land. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of three sub-areas within the Innherred freshwater system.

sekken-naturreservat-natc3f65603.d: Sekken Nature Reserve is a nature conservation area near Storfjellet, on the border with Steinkjer in Åfjord municipality in Trøndelag. The area is protected ‘to preserve a highly productive, thermophilic primeval forest of elm and spruce, and to protect the wildlife in the area. This type of forest is probably the last of its kind in Trøndelag’. The area was originally designated on 6 February 1987 and was extended on 31 August 2001. The reserve lies at an altitude of 166–490 metres above sea level on the hillside north of Sekkalona in Langvasselva.

holmdalen-og-langfjelldalen-naturreserva.d: The Holmdalen and Langfjelldalen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Nærøy and Høylandet. It comprises an area south of the Foldafjord. It was established on 21 June 2024 as an extension and amalgamation of the former nature reserves Holmdalen Nature Reserve (established in 2008) and Langfjelldalen–Holmdalen Nature Reserve (established in 2010). The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Motorised traffic on land and water is prohibited, including the landing and take-off of aircraft. Cycling is prohibited outside existing paths.

gipling-ya-fuglefredningsomrade-natc266b.d: The Giplingøya Wildlife Reserve is a bird sanctuary in Beitstadfjorden, off Framverran in Inderøy municipality, Trøndelag. The area was designated a protected area in 2003 ‘to preserve an important habitat for seabirds in a region with high levels of human activity’. Half of the protected area consists of the island itself, whilst the other half comprises the surrounding sea. The island lies 600 metres from the mainland and is characterised by livestock grazing. It is an important breeding ground for eider ducks and common gulls, and access is prohibited during the breeding season.

ulendeltaet-naturreservat-nat57e2ee6c.d: Ulendeltaet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and a Ramsar site in Lierne municipality in Trøndelag. The reserve was established in 1984 ‘to preserve an important wetland area with vegetation, birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area’. Ulendeltaet is situated at the mouth of the Innerdalselva river in Ulen, at an altitude of approximately 350 metres above sea level. It is a plain-like wetland area formed by alluvial deposits from the river, and is partially flooded during high water. Along the river grows a swamp forest of spruce and birch; behind this lies a large belt of willow and extensive marshes, characterised by tuft-forming grey moss. The area was designated a Ramsar site in 2011.

rin-naturreservat-nata83314a5.d: Ørin Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Verdal municipality, Trøndelag. The nature reserve is situated at the mouth of the Verdalselva river where it flows into Trondheimsfjorden, sandwiched between Verdalsbrua/the E6 and the Aker Solutions Verdal industrial site. The reserve forms part of the Trondheimsfjord wetland system and has Ramsar status, due to its importance for migratory birds. The reserve was established in 1993 to protect an intact river delta of great importance as a resting place for migratory wetland birds. The reserve comprises land, beach and sea. Originally, it bordered the Kausmofjæra bird sanctuary to the north.

fruflesa-naturreservat-natb394acb3.d: Fruflesa Nature Reserve is a nature reserve and a Ramsar site in Nærøysund municipality in Trøndelag. The area was designated to ‘preserve a distinctive archipelago area, with its naturally associated flora and fauna’, as part of a wider conservation plan in 2003. The conservation area consists of islands and islets to the west of Ytter-Vikna. The area is of great natural value. It is of particular importance as a breeding ground for seabirds. In 2013, the area was designated a Ramsar site as one of ten sub-areas within the Vest-Vikna coastal landscape.

vikaleiret-fuglefredningsomrade-natac15f.d: The Vikaleiret Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Inderøy municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important area comprising foreshore, land and shallow waters, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar Site. This is a mudflat, approximately 1.7 km long, situated between Hundstangen and Vikaholmen, south-west of Sund Folk High School. A characteristic feature of the site is the significant annual variation in the number of visiting migratory birds. In years with poor weather during the migration period, there is a tendency for birds to congregate at Vikaleiret.

tynesfj-ra-fuglefredningsomrade-nate946d.d: The Tynesfjæra Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Levanger municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important area comprising tidal flats, land and shallow waters, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar Site. The conservation area is situated a few kilometres north-east of Levanger town centre. The foreshore is divided into two by Tynestangen. The two separate foreshore areas, Kattangen–Tynestangen and Tynestangen–Borgsøya, together comprise approximately 4.5 km of shoreline. The latter is considered the most diverse bird habitat.

r-sheia-naturreservat-nat64155a1a.d: The Røsheia Nature Reserve was established in 2018 and is situated in Framverran in the municipality of Inderøy in Trøndelag. The nature reserve is situated in the former municipality of Mosvik and stretches for 7.9 km along the ridge between the Mossa-Meltingvatnet watercourse in the south and Verrasundet in the north. The highest point is at Solskinnshøgda, approximately 395 metres above sea level, whilst the lowest point is 175 metres above sea level. Much of the area consists of old pine forest. At Røsheia, the nature reserve extends above the tree line. The area was designated a nature reserve to preserve an area of mature, partly primeval-like forest of the oceanic pine forest type, together with its associated species. The objective also includes the conservation of the Sámi natural environment.

storengvatna-naturreservat-natf669b3ad.d: Storengvatna Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Namsos municipality. It comprises an area south of Salvatnet, within the Åarjel-Njaarken sijte (Vestre Namdal reindeer grazing district). The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Cycling is prohibited outside existing roads and paths shown in the management plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a varied area of old and largely undisturbed forest, which, with its diversity of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes, is of particular importance for biodiversity.’

skavdalen-naturreservat-nat01f63444.d: Skavdalen Nature Reserve was established in 2017 and is situated west of Skarnsundet in Inderøy municipality in Trøndelag. The nature reserve stretches 2.4 km from Småvika by Skarnsundet in the north-east, rising steeply and ruggedly up to Storlia at 380 metres above sea level in the south-west. The purpose of the conservation area is to preserve a diverse area of old and largely undisturbed forest. With its diversity of habitat types, ecosystems, species and natural ecological processes, the area is of particular importance for biodiversity, especially in relation to ravines, rich forest types and the vulnerable and rare species associated with these forest types. The objective also includes the conservation of the Sámi natural environment. The area has a high and varied level of species diversity.

falstadbukta-fuglefredningsomrade-natf96.d: The Falstadbukta Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Levanger municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important intertidal and shallow-water area, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar Site. The area comprises a large and elongated intertidal and shallow-water area (approximately 7 km of shoreline) just east of Ekne. The area encompasses the intertidal and shallow-water zones from the Ekne side in the west to Strandholmen in the east. The area is of some importance as a breeding and wintering ground for ducks, particularly eider and mallard.

bj-rga-fuglefredningsomrade-nated24bb85.d: The Bjørga Bird Sanctuary is a bird sanctuary in Verdal municipality, Trøndelag, established in 2003 to ‘protect birdlife and its habitats in an important area comprising tidal flats, land and shallow waters, along with the naturally associated flora and fauna that are vital to the birds’ habitat’. In 2014, the area was incorporated into the Trondheimsfjorden Wetland System Ramsar site. This is a tidal flat and shallow-water area with approximately 5.5 km of shoreline; north of Tronestangen and south of the Koa Tunnel on the border with Inderøy. Bjørga is a good birding site, particularly as a resting area for waders on migration. The concentration of great crested grebes in spring is particularly high.

urter-naturreservat-nat03fd0adc.d: The Urter Nature Reserve consists of islands out at sea to the west of Feøy in Karmøy municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islands is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

ryvingen-og-klovningen-naturreservat-nat.d: The Ryvingen and Klovningen Nature Reserve consists of two islets off the coast north-west of Åkrehamn in Karmøy municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islets is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding sites.’

lauvikholmen-naturreservat-nat6c42c129.d: Lauvikholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet off Aspøy in Høgsfjorden, in the municipality of Sandnes. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

oppsalholmen-naturreservat-nat97933845.d: Oppsalholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet off Vikedal in Sandeidfjorden. The nature reserve is situated in Vindafjord municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

jegningen-naturreservat-natc6483fe8.d: The Jegningen Nature Reserve consists of an islet north of Åkrehamn in Karmøy municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding sites.’

tedneholmen-naturreservat-natd9d2ac6a.d: Tedneholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet off Grastveit in Eigersund municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding sites.’

tingels-te-naturreservat-natb2096ec2.d: Tingelsæte Nature Reserve consists of an islet off Vibberodden Lighthouse in Eigersund municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

hylsskaret-naturreservat-natb4780040.d: Hylsskaret Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Suldal municipality. It comprises an area at the head of Hylsfjorden and extending inland to Suldalsvatnet. The area was designated a nature reserve on 27 November 2020 and extended on 20 December 2024. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Motorised traffic on land is prohibited, including the landing and take-off of aircraft. Outside the existing roads and cycle paths shown on the conservation map, the use of bicycles, horse-drawn carts and horse riding is prohibited.

tednholmen-naturreservat-nat22f1ddc7.d: Tednholmen Nature Reserve consists of an islet in Karmsundet near Avaldsnes in Karmøy municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding sites.’

svaholmane-naturreservat-natd0cb5bc2.d: Svåholmane Nature Reserve consists of a group of islets and skerries off Stapnes in Eigersund municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islets is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

strandaliane-naturreservat-nat49a1c7da.d: Strandaliane Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Suldal municipality. It comprises an area bordered to the north and west by Lake Suldalsvatnet. The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Outside existing roads and paths, the use of bicycles, horse-drawn carts and horse riding is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to protect a large, contiguous forest area with steep forest slopes from lowland to mountain, which has been little affected by recent human intervention. The area comprises poor boreal and boreonemoral pine and deciduous woodland, but also features, amongst other things, older boreonemoral broadleaf woodland and mixed deciduous woodland comprising elm, ash and other broadleaf trees.”

bjarvatnet-naturreservat-natfde17179.d: Bjårvatnet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hå municipality on Jæren, Rogaland. The area was designated a protected area in 1996 as an important migration and breeding ground for wetland birds. The marsh and reed beds in the inner part of the lake are an important breeding site for small birds that live in wetlands: the sedge warbler, the reed warbler, the grasshopper warbler and the reed bunting. The area is also a breeding ground for ducks and coots, and probably also for great crested grebes. It is also an important stopover and wintering site for ducks. The area is one of 22 protected areas forming part of the Jæren Wetland System Ramsar site, due to its importance for migratory birds. The Jæren Wetland System was established in 1985, and the number of sub-areas was expanded to 22 in 2002.

grudevatn-naturreservat-natf464d70e.d: Grudevatn Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Klepp municipality on Jæren, Rogaland. The area was designated a nature reserve in 1974 to preserve a specific habitat type and its rich birdlife. The conservation regulations were amended in 1987. The area also has a bird sanctuary surrounding the reserve. The lake is a very important breeding ground for a number of bird species. Nearly 200 species have been recorded in the area. The reserve is also very important for migratory and wintering birds. The Grudevatn wildlife conservation area is a fully cultivated buffer zone surrounding the nature reserve. The wildlife conservation area was established in 1974 and covers 1.9 km².

spannholmane-naturreservat-nat38c70e79.d: Spannholmane Nature Reserve consists of a group of islands south-west of Utsira in Utsira municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islands is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding grounds.’

vigre-naturreservat-natf56a8068.d: Vigre Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Hå municipality on Jæren, Rogaland. The area was designated a nature reserve in 1986 to preserve a rich fen of the ‘brunskjene’ type. The area has significant geological value and is the last remnant of what were once extensive areas of rich fen on Jæren. The fens have extremely species-rich vegetation, including many species that are rare in the region. The area is one of 22 protected areas that form part of the Jæren Wetland System Ramsar site, due to its importance for migratory birds. The Jæren Wetland System was established in 1985, and the number of sub-areas was expanded to 22 in 2002.

nordre-longaskjer-naturreservat-nat90313.d: The Nordre Longaskjer Nature Reserve consists of an islet north of Åkrehamn in Karmøy municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 7 May 1982 and is included in the seabird conservation plan. From 15 April to 1 August inclusive, landing on the islet is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important seabird site with the plant communities and animal species naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to the seabirds and their breeding sites.’

ulvenfjellet-naturreservat-natda02398a.d: Ulvenfjellet Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Bjørnafjorden municipality. It comprises an area near Osøyro. The area was designated a nature reserve on 11 December 2020. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Apart from existing roads, the use of bicycles, horses and carts, and horse riding are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of mature pine forest with elements of rich hazel thickets, hollow oaks and burnt areas. The aim is to preserve the conservation values in as undisturbed a state as possible, and, where appropriate, to further develop them.’

geitanosi-naturreservat-nata29422ee.d: The Geitanosi Nature Reserve comprises an area by the Nærøyfjord in Aurland municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 27 November 2020 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of a large, undisturbed forest area with a wide variety of forest and vegetation types. The area is of particular importance for biodiversity as large parts of it are characterised by primeval forest with a great deal of dead wood.’

bergsstronda-natureservat-nat4d8ff048.d: Bergsstronda Nature Reserve comprises an area by the Høyangsfjord in Høyanger municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 11 December 2020 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of rich deciduous forest typical of the fjord slopes around the central Sognefjord. Elm and lime forests of varying ages dominate the forest structure. There are also elements of other deciduous trees such as oak, hawthorn, hazel, black alder, grey alder and rowan.’

breisete-naturreservat-nat1eb9b7f1.d: The Breisete Nature Reserve comprises an area by Sogndalsfjøra in Sogndal municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 22 June 2018 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area with its biological and geological diversity, which represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of a large and largely undisturbed forest area with a wide variety of forestand vegetation types, large parts of which consist of old-growth forest. The area contains a great deal of dead wood.’

s-reb-dalen-naturreservat-nat296a481c.d: The Sørebødalen Nature Reserve comprises an area by Lake Øystrebøvatnet within Eiesfjorden in Høyanger municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 6 December 2019 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a large area representing a specific type of natural environment in the form of rich deciduous woodland and high-altitude pine and birch woodland, large parts of which consist of primeval-like mountain forest and highly productive old lowland pine forest. The area is of particular importance for biodiversity as it covers a continuous gradient from lowland to mountain terrain.”

rodeholene-naturreservat-nat9abe3638.d: The Rodeholene Nature Reserve comprises an area near Sogndal Airport, Haukåsen, in Sogndal municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 22 June 2018 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area with its biological and geological diversity, which represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of a large, largely undisturbed forest area with a wide variety of forestand vegetation types, large parts of which are characterised by primeval forest. The area contains a great deal of dead wood.”

stussvikhovda-naturreservat-natcd84737f.d: Stussvikhovda Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Kvinnherad and Bjørnafjorden. It comprises an area by Lukksundet. The area was designated a nature reserve on 11 December 2020. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Apart from existing roads, the use of bicycles, horse-drawn carts and horse riding is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of mature oceanic calcareous pine forest, rich deciduous forest and western Norwegian rainforest. The aim is to preserve the conservation values in as undisturbed a state as possible, and, where appropriate, to further develop them.’

bugen-naturreservat-natfbd1a65d.d: Bugen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Bremanger municipality. It comprises an area near Husefest in Kinn municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 6 December 2019 and extended on 11 December 2020 from approximately 385 dekar to approximately 840 dekar. The reserve is included in the forest conservation plan. Apart from existing tractor tracks and paths shown on the conservation map, the use of bicycles, horses and carts, and horse riding are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of a largely undisturbed, old and varied pine and birch forest containing several rare species.’

tingastad-naturreservat-nat2d2faee4.d: Tingastad Nature Reserve comprises an area on the Sognefjord in Sogndal municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 14 December 2018 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to protect a specific type of natural environment in the form of a large and largely undisturbed forest area with its geological and biological diversity. The aim is also to protect an area that is important for biodiversity, as it contains many types of forest and vegetation, including rich deciduous woodland and high-altitude pine and birch forests, where large parts consist of primeval-like mountain forest but also highly productive old lowland pine forest, and in that it encompasses a continuous gradient from fjord to mountain.”

festningen-naturreservat-nat91646a7c.d: Festningen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Flå municipality. It comprises an area by the Aurdalsfjord. The area was designated a nature reserve on 28 June 1985 and extended on 20 December 2024. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Motorised traffic is prohibited, including the landing and take-off of aircraft. b. Cycling, horse riding and the use of horses are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area representing specific types of natural habitat in the form of mature spruce forest with old trees and deadwood, and stream gorges with elements of tall-herb spruce forest. The aim is to maintain the conservation values in as undisturbed a state as possible, and, where appropriate, to further develop them.”

skasberget-naturreservat-nateedba849.d: Skasberget Nature Reserve is situated around the summit of Skasberget in Grue municipality, and on the upper slopes to the east, south and south-west. The reserve is bounded, amongst other things, by Skyttersætervegen to the south-west and by Lønhaugsvegen to the east. The bedrock consists of dioritic to granitic gneiss and migmatite. The most common type of vegetation is blueberry spruce forest, but on the hilltops there is more pine. In places, there are also mixed forests, small-fern forests, spruce swamp forests and pine bog forests. In places, the forest is old, and there is a fair amount of dead wood from spruce, pine and birch. Following the expansion of the nature reserve in 2019, a total of seven species of fungi and lichens have been identified that are on the Red List.

granbekken-og-drevja-naturreservat-natad.d: Granbekken and Drevja Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Trysil municipality. It comprises an area near Drevja, with the majority of the protected area lying south of the river. The area was designated a nature reserve on 21 June 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding are prohibited, except on roads and paths marked on the conservation map. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a large natural area with a wide variety of coniferous forest types, including riverside woodland and higher-altitude mixed coniferous forest, with elements of richer swamp forest types and spring areas’.

mes-termyre-naturreservat-nat1262549e.d: The Mesætermyre Nature Reserve consists of a bog-rich area near Grimsdalsgruva in Dovre municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 24 October 2003. From 20 April up to and including 15 July, access to the nature reserve is prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large and highly varied mire complex and the surrounding heathland and woodland communities as an ecosystem, including all natural flora and fauna. The area is of great scenic importance; it boasts a high level of species diversity, a rich birdlife and, in places, very rich and distinctive vegetation and flora, including several species of botanical interest, and features palsmyr bogs.”

mikkelsberget-naturreservat-nat4c01b8eb.d: Mikkelsberget Nature Reserve is an area of old coniferous forest surrounding Mikkelsberget in the far north-west of Grue municipality. The bedrock consists of granite and some eye gneiss, and the cover of loose material is mostly thin. The terrain is gently undulating with shallow fissure valleys, small bodies of water and bogs. The vegetation is generally sparse, comprising heather-pine forest, blueberry-spruce forest and minerotrophic mat bogs. A characteristic plant species is spiked sedge. In addition, there are a number of lichen and wood-dwelling fungi associated with old spruce, pine and birch. Ten Red List species have been recorded. Of particular note are good populations of both light and dark fire-stubble lichen.

n-rdsteb-berget-naturreservat-natf68f4b8.d: The Nørdstebøberget Nature Reserve comprises an area north of Etna on the border between the municipalities of Etnedal and Nordre Land. The area was designated a protected area on 16 December 2016 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a relatively large and contiguous area of particular importance for biodiversity, comprising old-growth forest with a very rich and varied array of species, a large proportion of which is rich lowland forest. Furthermore, the purpose of the nature reserve is to preserve an area containing habitat and forest types such as low-herb pine forest, low-herb spruce forest, tall-shrub spruce forest, swamp forest, rich hazel thickets and boreal deciduous forest.

risheim-yi-naturreservat-nat52930d74.d: Risheimøyi Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Skjåk and Lom. It comprises part of Skim. The area was designated a protected area on 12 October 1990. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area with vegetation, birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area, particularly with regard to migratory waterbirds.’

bj-rnhaugen-naturreservat-nat753971bd.d: Bjørnhaugen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Nordre Land municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 14 December 2018 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of old spruce forest. Furthermore, the purpose is to protect an area of particular importance for biodiversity, as it is a vital habitat for rare and endangered species such as the hollow-stemmed sedge and the endangered habitat type known as hay meadow."

bj-rnberga-og-isteren-naturreservat-nat8.d: The Bjørnberga and Isteren Nature Reserve comprises the land area between Isteren and Femunden in Engerdal municipality. This is a well-defined area, where the natural environment encompasses all transitions from large lakes to high mountains. The area is dominated by sparse pine forests. Most of it has been somewhat affected by past logging, but there are also patches of genuine primeval forest. In several places, there are pine trees that are 400–500 years old. The area shows clear signs of fire damage, and this plays an important role in forest dynamics. Its natural boundaries make the area well-suited for restoration, and natural disturbance processes such as forest fires can therefore be allowed to take their course almost unhindered.

skarvberget-og-tallasen-naturreservat-na.d: Skarvberget and Tallåsen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Rendalen municipality. It comprises an area east of Storsjøen, just north of Veksen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 21 June 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large natural area with a great deal of variation in coniferous forest types and extensive areas of pine forest with an unspoilt character, featuring patches of old heather-pine forest, rich spring-fed streams and rich fens. The area is of great importance for biodiversity as it provides a habitat for a number of natural forest species and lime-dependent species.

mel-yfloen-naturreservat-natb5e2d4af.d: The Meløyfloen Nature Reserve consists of wetland areas on both sides of the Einunna river in Folldal municipality. The area was designated a protected area on 18 December 1981 and is included in the wetland conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an important wetland area in its natural state and to protect the distinctive landscape features, vegetation, the particularly rich and interesting birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area.’

puttmyra-naturreservat-natb1d64206.d: Puttmyra Nature Reserve consists of a bog area near Kutjern station in Gran municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 18 January 1985 and is included in the conservation plan for mires. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve a virtually untouched, flat complex of nutrient-poor mires with interesting flora and vegetation.’

nevlingkollen-naturreservat-nat2ba3322f.d: Nevlingkollen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sør-Aurdal municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 28 June 1985 and is included in the forest conservation plan. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the designation is ‘to preserve typical high-altitude coniferous forest slopes that are of particular importance to wildlife.’

bj-rgedalen-naturreservat-nat8817d91c.d: Bjørgedalen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Ringsaker and Hamar in the Innlandet region. The reserve was established in 2000 to protect valuable geological formations and sensitive forest types. The area consists of a gorge, through the bottom of which the Flagstadelva river flows, forming the boundary between the municipalities of Hamar and Ringsaker. The bedrock consists of sedimentary rocks from the Cambrian, Ordovician and Silurian periods, including ortho-calcareous rock and shale with limestone lenses. This results in nutrient-rich soil. The shale layers are heavily folded and, in places, have been overturned so that the layers lie upside down. The dominant deciduous forest is elm and grey alder, but hazel, lime and hawthorn are also found here. The reserve is crossed by Bjørgedalsvegen.

skuta-naturreservat-nat9f353738.d: Skuta Nature Reserve comprises the eastern slope of the Skuta hill, just west of County Road 24 by Sætersjøen in Nord-Odal municipality. The topography is very steep in the northern part, and somewhat gentler elsewhere. The depth of the soil also varies, resulting in a wide variety of vegetation types. The area features old spruce forest, rich mixed woodland and poorer pine forest. Wildlife is protected against damage and unnecessary disturbance. The same applies to all vegetation, including dead shrubs and trees. However, hunting and the gathering of berries and mushrooms are permitted. Lighting campfires using dry twigs found on the ground is also permitted, subject to the other rules.

nekfallet-naturreservat-nat0b85556b.d: Nekfallet Nature Reserve is an area along the River Neka in Rendalen municipality. The area stretches from the mountains near the tree line in the east down to the county road along the Finstadåa in the west, with an elevation difference of 440 metres. The upper parts of the area lie within the northern boreal vegetation zone, whilst the lower quarter lies within the middle boreal zone. In the centre of the area, the Neka flows through a well-developed ravine to Nekfallet, where the river plunges steeply down towards the main valley. The conservation values are particularly linked to the ravine and Nekfallet, with the habitat types ‘waterfall mist forest’ and ‘waterfall spray zone’. Waterfall mist forests are rare, yet highly species-rich, containing several demanding and threatened plant species.

regnasen-og-hisasen-naturreservat-nat6bf.d: The Regnåsen and Hisåsen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Trysil municipality. It is an area of marshland and woodland situated north of Rysjøen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 21 June 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve a large natural area with a great deal of variation in coniferous forest and bog types, comprising extensive areas of old pine forest with elements of primeval forest. The area is of particular importance for biodiversity as it is home to a number of vulnerable and rare species associated with old-growth forest and deadwood. The aim is to maintain the conservation values in the best possible condition and, where possible, to further develop them.”

sjoa-naturreservat-natc91b3a7d.d: Sjoa Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Sel municipality. It comprises an area along the River Sjoa. The area was designated a nature reserve on 14 December 2018 and extended on 6 December 2024. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Motorised traffic on land and water is prohibited, including the landing and take-off of aircraft. The use of bicycles, horse-drawn carts and horse riding is prohibited outside the existing tractor tracks marked on the conservation map.

valsj-berget-og-andrasberget-naturreserv.d: The Valsjøberget and Andråsberget Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Rendalen municipality. It comprises an area to the east of the northern part of Lake Storsjøen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 21 June 2017. The reserve is part of the forest conservation plan. Cycling, horse-drawn carts and horse riding are prohibited, except on tractor tracks and paths marked on the conservation map. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve a large natural area with a wide variety of coniferous forest types, particularly the occurrences of old and primeval-like pine forest, with elements of calcareous pine forest, low-herb spruce forest and tall-shrub spruce forest.

rogberget-naturreservat-nat4393586f.d: Rogberget Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Åsnes municipality covering 315 dekar. The reserve was established on 7 December 2018. Rogberget is a hill in Kynndalen in Åsnes municipality, east of the existing Kynndalsmyrene Nature Reserve. The forest on the hill is coniferous, consisting of pine and spruce, with some willow, aspen, rowan and birch. The difference in altitude is approximately 100 metres from the lowest point to the highest. The bedrock is partly rich and consists of dioritic to granitic gneiss, migmatite, gabbro and amphibolite. This gives rise to a rich flora.

fluberg-fuglefredningsomrade-nat6c897105.d: The Fluberg Bird Sanctuary is a protected bird reserve featuring shallow waters and mudflats in Søndre Land municipality in the Innlandet region. The area has been specifically protected to safeguard its rich birdlife and the birds’ habitats, with particular regard to waterbirds migrating along the Randsfjord. The area covers 689 dekar and lies 135 metres above sea level in a narrow section of the fjord. The area’s greatest significance lies in its role as a resting place for migratory birds, particularly during the spring and autumn migrations. At these times, the water level is low and the mudflats are exposed, allowing waterbirds and waders to access insects and other small creatures. This is why the area is important for migratory birds passing along Randsfjorden.

svarthaugan-naturreservat-natf03d571c.d: The Svarthaugan Nature Reserve comprises an area in the Kakell Valley in Folldal municipality. The area was designated a nature reserve on 22 December 1989 on the basis of its Quaternary geology. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area of natural historical interest with important Quaternary geological features, including a large and well-formed glacial margin deposit.’

galtsj-en-naturreservat-nat622d11ff.d: Galtsjøen Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in the municipalities of Engerdal and Rendalen. It consists of a wetland area that includes Lake Galtsjøen and forms part of the Trysil watercourse. The area was designated a nature reserve on 18 December 1981. The reserve is included in the wetland conservation plan. Motorised traffic, camping, pitching tents and setting up camouflaged hides for photography are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the protection is ‘to preserve an important wetland area in its natural state and to protect the vegetation, the particularly rich and interesting birdlife and other wildlife naturally associated with the area.’ Ducks reside here for most of the year.

kvisleflaet-og-hovdlia-naturreservat-nat.d: The Kvisleflået and Hovdlia Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Engerdal municipality in the Innlandet region. The nature reserve is situated on the Swedish border, east of County Road 26, south-east of Drevsjø. The reserve was established in 1981 under the name Kvisleflået Nature Reserve, covering an area of 33 km²; it was expanded and renamed in 2005 as part of the Forest Conservation Plan. It was designated a Ramsar site in 2002, due to the importance of its marshlands for bird migration. The landscape is a complex pattern of old and dead pine forest, bogs and ponds; and it is an important breeding habitat, particularly for the common snipe and the little curlew. Among the more distinctive and rare breeding species are the whooper swan and the dunlin.

kalvberget-naturreservat-nat34e7d621.d: Kalvberget Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Østre Toten municipality. It comprises an area on Totenåsen north of Bergsjøen. The area was designated a nature reserve on 15 December 2017. The reserve forms part of the forest conservation plan. Horse riding and the use of horses and carts are prohibited. The conservation regulations state that the purpose of the conservation is ‘to preserve an area that represents a specific type of natural environment in the form of old, coarse pine forest, and which is of particular importance for biodiversity as it provides a habitat for the hollow-stemmed birch and other endangered species. The aim is to maintain the conservation values in as undisturbed a state as possible, and, where appropriate, to further develop them.”

selsj-en-naturreservat-nat46f4610b.d: The Selsjøen Nature Reserve (approximately 30,100 daa) is situated in the municipalities of Søndre Land and Ringerike and encompasses the forested areas around Steinvarden (772 metres above sea level), on the border between Buskerud and Oppland, south-west of Selsjøen. The purpose of the nature reserve is to preserve a large and relatively undisturbed forest area comprising old-growth natural coniferous forest. The nature reserve was established by Royal Decree 25 January 2013 pursuant to the Act of 19 June 2009 No. 100 on the Management of Biodiversity (the Biodiversity Act), Section 34, cf. Sections 37 and 62. Proposed by the Ministry of the Environment. Amended by Regulation No. 284 of 15 March 2013 (in force from 1 July 2013). The bedrock consists of nutrient-poor gneiss with sparse loose deposits on top.

veslehjerkinntj-nnin-naturreservat-nate5.d: Veslehjerkinntjønnin Nature Reserve is a nature reserve in Dovre municipality, situated on the watershed between the Gautåe and Tverråe rivers, south of Hjerkinn. The reserve lies at an altitude of around 1,250 metres above sea level and is entirely surrounded by Dovre National Park. The reserve comprises a varied wetland area featuring both large and small ponds, as well as bogs and lush marshes. The area is an important breeding ground for ducks and waders, and is home to a high level of biodiversity relative to its altitude. It is also home to some of the country’s southernmost palsmyren bogs, as well as large populations of the red-listed grynsildre.
